Sure! Here’s a quick note you can save somewhere handy (e.g., a notes app, your phone’s “Reminders” app, or a calendar event) to remind you about renewing your Netflix subscription on **March 27th**: --- **📅 March 27 – Netflix Subscription Reminder** - **Action:** Renew Netflix subscription - **Details:** - Check current plan and billing cycle - Verify payment method is up‑to‑date - Confirm any promotional offers or discounts - **Deadline:** 24 hours before the renewal date (March 26) to avoid any service interruption - **Notes:** - If you’re switching plans, compare the new plan’s price and features. - Consider setting auto‑renew to avoid future manual reminders. --- ### How to set a reminder | Platform | Steps | |----------|-------| | **iPhone / iPad** | 1. Open **Reminders** app.
2. Tap **New Reminder**.
3. Enter the title (“Netflix Subscription”).
4. Tap the **info (i)** icon → **Remind me on a day** → Set date to **March 27** and time (e.g., 9 AM).
5. Optionally add a note or location. | | **Android** | 1. Open **Google Calendar** or **Google Keep**.
2. Create a new event/ note titled “Netflix Subscription”.
3. Set date to **March 27** and choose a notification time. | | **Windows** | 1. Use **Microsoft To‑Do** or **Outlook Calendar**.
2. Create a task/event for March 27. | | **Mac** | 1. Open **Calendar** or **Reminders**.
2. Add a new event/task for March 27. | Feel free to copy the note above into your preferred app and set the reminder. That way you’ll get a notification on March 27 (or earlier, if you prefer) and won’t miss your Netflix renewal!
